verification.welcome.p1: To comply with international financial regulations and ensure the highest tier of security for your assets, we require a one-time identity verification (KYC).

verification.terms.title: Service Agreement
verification.terms.s1.title: 1. KYC COMPLIANCE
verification.terms.s1.body: By proceeding, you agree to provide valid, government-issued identification. We utilize state-of-the-art encryption to protect your documentation. Accounts failing to verify within 30 days may face temporary service limitations.
verification.terms.s2.title: 2. DATA PROTECTION
verification.terms.s2.body: Finvex Bank adheres to GDPR and international data standards. Your identity details are used strictly for regulatory compliance and are never shared with third-party marketing entities.
verification.terms.s3.title: 3. TERMINOLOGY
